items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So we became good friends there and he used to come over everytime he had a chance, when they weren't out.

ctx.x: One day I heard a knock on the door. I hadn't met him then, but I heard a knock on the door and he opened the door. "I'm Lester Young," he says. "I hear that little saxophone. Who is that playing saxophone? I said, Frankie Trumbauer. He said, well, do you mind if I listen? So he came in and we met, you know. And he started to borrow these records. And he used to tell me he had an old, beat-up alto but one of these days when he learned how to read good his father was going to buy him a new Selmer (PHONETIC).
So we became good friends there and he used to come over everytime he had a chance, when they weren't out.
